WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_CollectionExtract(ST_MakeValid(ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-89.425369 45.206033, -89.446162 45.206193, -89.456247 45.206299, -89.46659 45.206178, -89.500171 45.206374, -89.549052 45.20648, -89.559201 45.20639, -89.57229 45.206465, -89.5898 45.206299, -89.589809 45.213525, -89.589894 45.235394, -89.589894 45.257254, -89.589913 45.260957, -89.589959 45.270076, -89.589966 45.271744, -89.589985 45.27548, -89.590002 45.279046, -89.589937 45.288059, -89.589937 45.290013, -89.589937 45.293841, -89.576355 45.293886, -89.569283 45.293878, -89.563523 45.293871, -89.548438 45.29375, -89.424772 45.29318, -89.425369 45.206033))',4326)), 3) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
area_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(ST_Area(parks.geometry::geography)) AS area
  FROM parks
  WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve'
    AND ST_Intersects(parks.geometry::geography, (SELECT g::geography FROM region))
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, buffered_region r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
),
slope_agg AS (
  SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).mean AS slope
  FROM region_slope
)
SELECT a.area, s.slope
FROM area_sum a, slope_agg s;

WITH schley_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Schley'
    AND border_type = 'county'
    AND addr_state = 'Wisconsin'
),
nature_reserves AS (
  SELECT parks.geometry
  FROM parks
  JOIN schley_region
    ON ST_Intersects(parks.geometry::geometry, schley_region.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE parks.leisure = 'nature_reserve'
),
raster_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ST_Area(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, true, nature_reserves.geometry::geometry))) AS cumulative_nature_reserve_area,
    ROUND(AVG(ST_Degree(ST_Slope(public.dem_us.rast, 1))), 2) AS mean_slope_degrees
  FROM public.dem_us
  JOIN schley_region
    ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, schley_region.geometry::geometry)
  LEFT JOIN nature_reserves
    ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, nature_reserves.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(cumulative_nature_reserve_area / 1000000, 2) AS cumulative_nature_reserve_area_sq_km,
  mean_slope_degrees
FROM raster_analysis;
